items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: And we organized a band there called Alexander's Ragtime Jazz Band. Old Dave Alexander. We named it after him.

ctx.x: John Johnson. You want to go there one time?

Yeah. I want to get that myself up. Well, now, let's see. I was telling you about going down to Houston there. And I learned to lead a bunch of fellas, what the responsibilities was. I did pretty good after that. I got started. And I went off with a, left here, left Sid Isles, and went off with a carnival, carnival show. The boys said they were going down to Mexico, and I'd never been to Mexico, and I wanted to get away and go down to Mexico. So I just forgot about school, went on down there. The old man Sid…

It's alright when the red light go on. Go ahead. When the red light would go on then you start to recording. Now the man in the back that's recording it, there was a little light thread would come off of that disc and it would pile up and then you'd have to wrap it up and take it off and throw it on the floor. And that was one continuous operation until you cut the disc and then the lights would go on and nobody said a word, nothing dropped on the floor, you couldn't breathe too hard. That's right.
